description: This Java source file defines a class 'ClearEntityCaches' which implements an operation for clearing entity caches within the MiniLang framework of the Apache OFBiz project. It includes validation, a constructor, execution logic to clear caches via a Delegator object, and a nested factory class for instantiation.

classes.name: ClearEntityCaches
classes.description: Implements the \<clear-entity-caches\> element as an entity operation that clears all caches in the specified Delegator.

classes.name: ClearEntityCachesFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of ClearEntityCaches for the \<clear-entity-caches\> element.

methods.name: ClearEntityCaches
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the operation, performing validation if enabled.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the cache clearing operation by invoking clearAllCaches() on the Delegator.
